about: The regression corpus (tools/corpus.py): recorded sessions in the test install's sessions\ (and sessions-2\), by name only. exe = the race.exe it was recorded on (beside the port's dinput.dll). ini = extra viperport.ini settings for its replays. routes = how it must replay IDENTICAL: dll (rewrites), original (MGI's code; never for a session that visits Options), standalone (viperport.exe --race exe). provisional = recorded before the corpus existed, kept for what the fresh set lacks (the stock race.exe, career saves).

sessions.name: paint-race
sessions.what: fresh set 1: paint kit (paint0 saved), one race, quit from the menu

sessions.name: vrmod-jeeps
sessions.what: fresh set 2: vrmod-patched race.exe, Indy jeep then Willys (32,768 lit-vertex lift), hornballs; picked in Options/Hacks, so no original route

sessions.name: editor
sessions.what: fresh set 3: model editor (Ctrl+E): every tool, import cube.dxf, export cube.3ds, save cube2.mod; file boxes recorded

sessions.name: lan-1
sessions.what: fresh set 4: two-copy UDP LAN race with AI cars, copy 1 (host), 3.5 min

sessions.name: lan-2
sessions.what: fresh set 4: the same race, copy 2 (client), replayed alone

sessions.name: sp-stock
sessions.what: kept: the only session on the stock exe; single-player race (S1 check; DPI-virtualised 1536x864: race_stock.exe has no HIGHDPIAWARE flag)

sessions.name: libc-career
sessions.what: kept: the only career save; LIBC check: menus, career + paint kit saves, 2 races
